snippet.title: Frenetika | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist today: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3971280/FRENETIKA/

FRENETIKA has you take control of a Mage trapped in the domain of the Bone God, Osso. Inspired bygames like Vampire Survivors, Doom, and Risk of Rain 2, along with the dark-fantasy minds of Moebius, Plastiboo, and Lloyd Alexander, and featuring a soundtrack by dungeon-synth pioneer Witch Bolt. 

In an endless series of combat arenas hand-crafted to maximize fast, frenetic combat, players cast spells to defeat the skeletal servants of Osso sent to kill the invading Mage. As these servants are dispatched, their bones are collected and used to purchase crystal fractals – upgrades – which improve and change the Mage’s three core spells. What combination will you find to help finally extinguish Osso’s oppressing darkness?

Also included in FRENETIKA is a novella detailing how the Mage found herself in Osso’s domain. Find all five volumes hidden throughout the game and you’ll be given a password to unlock the e-book version of the novella that’s included in the game files. 

***FRENETIKA IS AN AI-FREE GAME. NO AI OR LLM WAS USED IN THE CREATION OF ANY ASSET IN THIS GAME (TO THE KNOWLEDGE OF THE DEVELOPER)***
